# awscc_chime_channel (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Chime::Channel



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `app_instance_arn` (String) The ARN of the AppInstance that contains the channel.
- `arn` (String) The ARN of the channel.
- `channel_flow_arn` (String) The ARN of the channel flow.
- `channel_id` (String) The ID of the channel. When omitted, the service generates a UUID.
- `chime_bearer` (String) The ARN of the AppInstanceUser or AppInstanceBot that performs every operation on this channel. Whichever of the two creates a channel automatically becomes one of its moderators, so the same ARN can subsequently read, update and delete the channel.
- `created_by` (Attributes) The AppInstanceUser or AppInstanceBot that created the channel. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--created_by))
- `created_timestamp` (String) The time at which the channel was created.
- `elastic_channel_configuration` (Attributes) The attributes required to configure and create an elastic channel. An elastic channel must use RESTRICTED mode, cannot be created with MemberArns, and is available only in some regions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--elastic_channel_configuration))
- `expiration_settings` (Attributes) Settings that control the interval after which the channel is automatically deleted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--expiration_settings))
- `last_message_timestamp` (String) The time at which a member sent the last message in the channel.
- `last_updated_timestamp` (String) The time at which the channel was last updated.
- `member_arns` (List of String) The ARNs of the AppInstanceUsers to add to the channel as members when it is created. Cannot be combined with ElasticChannelConfiguration.
- `metadata` (String) The metadata of the channel.
- `mode` (String) The channel mode. In an UNRESTRICTED channel, members can add themselves and other members; in a RESTRICTED channel, only administrators and moderators can add members. An elastic channel must be RESTRICTED.
- `moderator_arns` (List of String) The ARNs of the AppInstanceUsers to add to the channel as moderators when it is created.
- `name` (String) The name of the channel.
- `privacy` (String) The channel's privacy level. A PUBLIC channel is discoverable by anyone in the AppInstance; a PRIVATE channel is not. Privacy cannot be changed after creation.
- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags for the channel. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Nested Schema for `created_by`

Read-Only:

- `arn` (String) The ARN in an identity.
- `name` (String) The name in an identity.


<a id="nestedatt--elastic_channel_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `elastic_channel_configuration`

Read-Only:

- `maximum_sub_channels` (Number) The maximum number of SubChannels allowed in the elastic channel.
- `minimum_membership_percentage` (Number) The minimum allowed percentage of TargetMembershipsPerSubChannel users, used to balance members across SubChannels.
- `target_memberships_per_sub_channel` (Number) The maximum number of members allowed in a SubChannel.


<a id="nestedatt--expiration_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `expiration_settings`

Read-Only:

- `expiration_criterion` (String) The condition the expiration period is measured from.
- `expiration_days` (Number) The period in days after which the system automatically deletes the channel.

### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The key in a tag.
